thread:
anna: Quick sync — closing out the DR postmortem action items. I pulled the hotlist, 7 open items. Need owners & realistic timelines.
kevin: I'll own the multi-region routing audits + reroute playbook. ETA: EOW next week.
maya: I'll take backups verification and documented restore steps. Will run a full test restore in staging on Friday.
lee: I'll coordinate the game-day dry run and rota handovers. Propose Thu 09:30 PT. Anyone blocked?
kevin: Not blocked. Question: do we want the routing tests to include the cold-region sim? That adds ~30m.
anna: Yes include cold-region sim. Add it to checklist so ops knows expected window.
maya: Adding checklist to the runbook now. I'll paste the minimal restore test steps here so they're discoverable:
```
- snapshot: validate latest incremental exists: `gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="name~'redwood-.*'"`
- restore: spin test cluster: `kops create cluster --name=dr-test` (or use infra tool)
- sanity: hit health endpoint `/healthz` and run smoke load: `siege -c10 -t30s http://dr-test.app/`
- validate data: select 3 sample keys and compare checksums with prod snapshot
```
lee: Nice. Can you also add the exact IAM role we use for snapshot reads? Avoid surprises during game day.
maya: Added `roles/storage.objectViewer` to the runbook section. Also flagged that the service account needs access to project `redwood-dr-testing`.
kevin: For routing tests: I'll produce a small script to flip a region route and measure failover time. Plan to put results in the incident board.
anna: Sounds good. Owner notes:
- multi-region routing audit -> kevin -> due 2166050000 (UNIX)
- backups + restore doc + staging restore -> maya -> due 2165850000
- game-day dry run + rota -> lee -> due 2165720000
- runbook IAM checks -> maya -> due 2165650000
- followup post-dry-run retro -> anna, all -> due 2165900000
kevin: I also want to call out recurring pattern: we saw partial KV-cache invalidation during regional failovers twice in the last 6 months. Can we add a check in the runbook to validate cache population after routing flips?
lee: Good catch. Add a post-failover cache-validation step and tie to `ops-bot` alert if miss rate > 5% for 10m.
ops-bot: reminder: scheduled runbook tests will post results to #incidents and add a summary to the incident tracker.
anna: Ok team — I'll create the action-tracker card and ping owners directly. If anyone needs help with infra creds or test quotas, @kevin/@maya/lee, shout here. :thumbsup:
kevin: A few quick followups: I'll attach the routing script + instructions after I run the first sim.
maya: I'll confirm snapshot retention policies and whether we need extended retention for the next quarter.
lee: I'll lock the dry-run time and update on-call rotation. Will also invite SREs from EU region.
anna: Closing note: primary goal is a repeatable playbook with clear owners and a 2hr SLA for initial restore verification during drills. We'll reconvene after the dry run retro. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
